test_basic_cache: test that steps and chains cache results with or without input using the Cached backend
test_intermediate_cache: test that intermediate steps in a Chain are independently cached and survive chain cache clears
test_mode_readonly: test that read-only mode fails without cache but works after cache is populated
test_mode_force: test that force mode recomputes once then resets to cached mode for subsequent calls
test_force_propagates_downstream: test that force mode on an intermediate step propagates recomputation to all downstream steps
